## Programme and price

VIVA MEXICO 2026

12 days / 11 nights

The programme operates on Wednesdays and Fridays.

The programme starts in Mexico City.

Three legendary regions and twelve unforgettable days bringing together culture, history and nature.

● This comprehensive itinerary connects Mexico's most iconic destinations, from the majestic pyramids of Teotihuacan and the colonial elegance of Oaxaca to the mystical cenotes of the Yucatán and the turquoise shores of Cancún.

● Carefully designed for travellers who want to experience Mexico in depth without rushing, this programme combines historical discovery, encounters with artisans, outdoor adventures and regional cuisine in one story-filled journey.

● It is ideal for those who want more than a holiday: travellers seeking connection, context and unforgettable beauty, accompanied by experienced local guides throughout.

● Stand beneath the Pyramid of the Sun in Teotihuacan.

● Explore the Zócalo in Mexico City, Santo Domingo Church in Oaxaca, and the artisan neighbourhoods of Mexico City and Oaxaca.

● Cruise the canals of Xochimilco and stroll through Coyoacán and San Ángel.

● Wander the ruins of Monte Albán, Uxmal and Mitla.

● Taste authentic mezcal at its source and meet Oaxaca's master artisans.

● Swim in the cenotes of Santa Bárbara and visit Chichén Itzá.

## Prices, dates and accommodation

The programme is not available on the following dates: 28 March – 5 April, 11 June – 5 July, 15 July – 31 July, spring break, 29 March – 5 April, 15–31 July, 26 October – 3 November, 16 December – 4 January 2027.
